patch_description: Add an intra-block RY(theta) rotation layer between the skip-2 CZ sub-ring (2b) and the antipodal CZ shortcuts (2c), reusing the shared "theta" parameter (no new trainable parameter introduced). This interleaves an additional non-commuting rotation axis directly amid the entangling gates, which previous experiments suggest increases circuit expressivity and can improve convergence speed while keeping parameter count fixed at 8 (1 unique parameter x 8 uses per layer... actually shared single "theta" so n_params stays same). This should help reduce convergence steps back toward 30 while maintaining perfect train/val/test accuracy.
